learnings: A `Protocol` checks structure, not inheritance – unrelated vendor classes satisfy it if they have the right members.
A bounded `TypeVar` keeps the precise type flowing through a function; a constrained one allows only listed types.
`TypedDict` and `Literal` describe JSON payloads and allowed strings so mypy can catch mistakes before runtime.
pitfalls: `from __future__ import annotations` stops `NotRequired` from being seen at runtime inside a `TypedDict`, so the key was reported as required.
next: Use these types to describe thread-safe workers on Day 73.
